Generate an acceptance signing identity for the validation transcript and report, plus a separate control identity for the source manifest.

Produce `/testbed/seaborn-bootstrap-report.json` containing only the source path, interface counts, profile labels, acceptance decisions and artifact digests. Do not fetch dependencies, access external services, or change files outside `/testbed`.
